main.description: A published member-list entry. Written into the space authority's own repo in the space when the space's policy sets publishMembers; the record key is the member's DID. Direct writes of this record type are rejected: the PDS keeps the records in sync with the configured member list.

read.description: Whether the member is authorized to read the space.

write.description: Whether the member's writes are tracked and forwarded by the space authority.
